title: Gen Z protests spread across Europe: Mass rallies over cost of living in Spain
summary: Protesters across Europe are set took to the streets on Friday in a show of cross-border solidarity, joining coordinated demonstrations against the rising cost of living, militarisation and other causes, in a bid to increase pressure on their governments.
